description: Every Argo CD Application tracks main, so a merged bump goes live. Patches pool into one PR and automerge once validate passes; minor/major bumps get a PR per component and wait for a human. Rook, Talos and the vendored KubeVirt/CDI manifests never automerge.

customManagers.description: root-app versions: map, one `# renovate:` annotation above each pin.
Headlamp KubeVirt plugin: digest of :latest (upstream publishes no semver tags).
Talos defaults: gen-config.sh / proxmox.sh `TALOS_VERSION:=`, env.example and the header examples, and the tofu talos_version variable.
Gateway API CRDs that bootstrap.sh installs before Cilium.
vendor.sh KubeVirt default and its usage example.

packageRules.description: Patches from every component share one PR and automerge after validate passes and the release is 7 days old.
A digest of a moving tag can be anything; review it like a minor.
Gateway API: the root-app CRD source and the bootstrap.sh CRD install move together.
Rook: both charts follow versions.rookCeph. Never automerge, and Rook can't skip a minor, so each minor gets its own PR.
Talos: every default moves together. Never automerge; `talosctl upgrade` one minor at a time, so each minor gets its own PR.
prBodyNotes: Bumping the defaults doesn't upgrade a running cluster: run `talosctl upgrade` node by node. Check that `kubernetes_version` in `tofu/variables.tf` still matches the new talosctl default.

packageRules.description: KubeVirt: vendor.sh default and versions.kubevirt move together. Never automerge: the vendored manifest only changes when vendor.sh runs.
prBodyNotes: This only bumps the pins. Run `app/charts/vendor.sh` on this branch and commit `app/charts/kubevirt/templates/operator.yaml` before merging.

packageRules.description: CDI: vendor.sh default and versions.cdi move together. Never automerge: the vendored manifest only changes when vendor.sh runs.
prBodyNotes: This only bumps the pins. Run `app/charts/vendor.sh` on this branch and commit `app/charts/cdi/templates/operator.yaml` before merging.
